alerts._comment: Email alerts from the agent itself (src/agent/alerts.py). The mail server and recipient come from environment variables, never from this file: ALERT_EMAIL_TO, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM, SMTP_SECURITY (see .env.example). The same alert is not sent again within its cooldown; non-critical mail is capped per hour. Every alert is also recorded in data/alerts.jsonl, sent or not.

self_healing._comment: What the agent does about its own failures (src/agent/self_healing.py). A background worker that dies is restarted, at most max_restarts_per_hour times. A halt caused by the loop freezing (never any other halt: not a loss limit, not the operator's button) is lifted once the loop and the primary broker have been healthy for healthy_seconds, at most max_per_day times a day; set auto_resume.enabled to false to make every halt wait for a person. The operator is emailed at these loop-error counts in a row, and every loop_error_repeat_every after; and when a symbol has had no real price for degraded_symbol_minutes.

learning._comment: Learning from every signal's later price move, not only from closed trades (src/agent/signal_ledger.py). The agent records what each strategy's signals did 5 and 20 trading days later, per market, and the scorecard shows each strategy's hit rate against chance. With signal_skill_tilt.enabled false (the default) it only measures. Set it to true and, once a strategy has min_signals signals with a known outcome in a market, its vote there is scaled 0.5x to 1.5x by how far it beats chance (guardrails.signal_tilt). Review the scorecard's Learning section before switching it on.

scorecard._comment: The bar the ninety-day paper run has to clear (src/agent/scorecard.py). Approved by the operator on 30 September 2026. Change a number here and the dashboard and scripts/agent_scorecard.py follow. max_drawdown_pct is left out on purpose: it follows risk_management.max_drawdown, so the account's own limit is the target; add it here to override that.

llm_allocator._comment: An AI re-weighting of the strategies, OFF by default: the ensemble already tilts each strategy by its realised results (guardrails.evidence_tilt), and the AI is shown nothing more. To layer an AI on top set enabled to true; it then asks at most once a day, and only after min_new_trades more trades have closed.

bias_check._comment: Herding check (src/agent/bias_detector.py): a new buy waits when this many other symbols in the same market (US stocks, crypto, forex) already had a buy approved in the last 24 hours, so the agent spreads new positions out instead of piling in at once. Sells are never held back.

data_manager._symbol_lists: Two kinds of list. TRADING lists say what the agent acts on: `symbols` is walked by the main loop every trading_loop_interval seconds, `nse_symbols` by the NSE pass every nse_eval_interval seconds during Nairobi hours. CLASSIFICATION lists say how a symbol is costed: `crypto_symbols` is expected to overlap `symbols`, since a pair must be in `symbols` to be traded and in `crypto_symbols` to be priced as crypto rather than as a US equity. An overlap between the two trading lists would be a real conflict; an overlap with the classification list is intended.
data_manager._forex_symbols: Currency pairs traded on the forex paper book (brokers.forex_paper), written BASE_QUOTE. Only pairs quoted in US dollars, so the book's value stays in dollars: EUR_USD, GBP_USD, AUD_USD, NZD_USD. Like crypto_symbols, a pair must also be in `symbols` to be traded. Long only, no leverage.

nse.comment: Kenyan NSE via Afristox + Mansa APIs

market_overrides._comment: Forex only: a major pair moves about 0.5% a day against a stock's 1.5%, so the 2% bar above almost never crossed there (about one buy day a year per pair). 0.6% gives forex about the pace stocks have.
Forex only, for the same reason as momentum's: a 2% band around the 20-day average is rarely reached by a currency pair.

crypto_trend._comment: Crypto only (src/agent/slow_strategies.py). Holds a coin while its close is more than `band` above its sma_period-day average, sells when it is more than `band` below, and otherwise has no view. Long-only, no leverage; sized by volatility like every trade. strategy_markets makes it crypto's only voter.

forex_trend._comment: Forex only (src/agent/slow_strategies.py). The forex counterpart of crypto_trend: holds a pair while its close is more than `band` above its sma_period-day average and sells when it is more than `band` below. Long-only, no leverage. Unlike crypto it votes alongside momentum and mean reversion (their forex thresholds are set in market_overrides), so it confirms a trend rather than trading alone. It abstains until it has sma_period daily bars.

nse_rotation._comment: NSE only. Ranks the NSE stocks by their return over `lookback` trading days ending `skip` days ago (about six months, skipping the latest month); the top_n with a positive return are buys, and a holding outside the top exit_rank, or with a negative return, is a sell. Abstains until at least min_universe stocks have lookback + skip + 1 days of real history.

us_earnings_drift._comment: US shares only. After an earnings beat of at least min_surprise (actual versus the analysts' estimate), a buy for hold_days calendar days, fading over the window; after a miss of that size, a sell. Needs TRADING_FINNHUB_API_KEY; without it, and outside a report's window, it abstains.

cash_policy._max_risk_multiplier_note: Multiplier on trading.risk_per_trade, not a position cap. 1.0 normally; up to this when the book is under-deployed AND confidence clears min_confidence_to_boost. Replaces base_risk_per_trade/max_risk_per_trade, which were notional caps that competed with risk_limits.max_position_size and ignored volatility. 2.5 preserves the old 5%/2% ratio.

tbill_switch._comment: Value against Treasury bills: when the median earnings yield (earnings per share / price) of the stocks the sleeve can buy is below the T-bill rate after 15% withholding tax, the sleeve skips that month and the money stays in bills. The rate is benchmarks.tbill_rate_pct unless tbill_rate_pct is set here.

forex_paper._comment: The forex paper book: a simulated account inside the agent, filled at live Yahoo Finance prices (never at an old one), with about one pip of spread a side. Kept in data/forex_paper_state.json. Alpaca does not trade currencies.

add_to_winners._comment: US/crypto book (src/agent/position_rules.py). A buy signal on a holding in one of `markets` adds to it only when selling it all now would already be profitable after costs, the price is at least min_gain_pct above the last entry, fewer than max_adds adds have been made, and the position stays within max_position_pct of equity. Entries are capped at risk_limits.max_position_size, so this cap sits a little above it. Add "crypto" to markets to let crypto add too.

exits._comment: All markets in the US/crypto book. A sell signal at or above full_exit_confidence closes the position; a weaker one sells trim_fraction of it, at most once a day, unless what would remain is under min_remaining_pct of equity. Stops always close in full.

trading._risk_per_trade_note: THE authority for position size. Fraction of equity lost if a position's stop is hit. Notional = equity * risk_per_trade * cash_policy multiplier / (risk_limits.stop_loss_atr_mult * ATR%), then capped at risk_limits.max_position_size. At 0.5% risk with 2.5x ATR stops the 5% cap binds below about 4% ATR, so quiet instruments sit at the cap and volatile ones are sized down. Both the live loop and the backtest use this same formula (src/agent/position_sizing.volatility_scaled_value).

self_assessment._comment: The AI stop-setting review waits for min_closed_trades closed round trips, then asks again only after min_new_trades more. It is advice only.

nse_paper_trading._comment: The agent's NSE paper account (src/agent/nse_paper_account.py). With nse_auto_paper_trade on (the default), NSE tickets fill as paper trades against this cash, net of the NSE costs below, under the backtest's rules: no adding to a holding, no short selling, sells close the whole position. Remove or set to 0 to go back to leaving tickets pending for the operator.

add_to_winners._comment: A buy signal on a holding adds to it only when selling the whole position now would already be profitable after costs, the price is at least min_gain_pct above the last entry, fewer than max_adds adds have been made, and the position stays within max_position_pct of the account at cost. Each add is add_size_pct of a new position's size. Set enabled to false to never add.

exits._comment: A sell signal at or above full_exit_confidence closes the position; a weaker one sells trim_fraction of it, at most once a day, unless what would remain is under min_remaining_pct of the account, which closes it instead. partial_exits false always closes.

stop_loss._comment: Checked every NSE evaluation before any signal: a position is sold in full when the price is stop_loss_pct below its cost (fees included) or trailing_stop_pct below the highest price since it opened. Where the stock's ATR is known the stops scale to risk_limits' ATR multiples, but never tighter than these: a round trip costs about 3.9% with slippage, and a stop tripped by an ordinary day's noise pays that for nothing.

nse_paper_trading._cash_yield_note: Idle cash earns interest daily, as if swept into a money market fund or T-bills, with 15% withholding tax on the interest. Leave cash_yield_pct out to use benchmarks.tbill_rate_pct; set it to 0 to switch interest off.

trading_limits._comment: How often and how big the paper account may trade (src/agent/nse_paper_account.py). An order is capped at max_adv_fraction of the stock's average daily volume over adv_days; a signal cannot sell a position held for less than min_holding_days (stops still can); at most max_new_positions_per_week new holdings are opened in any 7 days (adds do not count); and sale proceeds are not spendable until settlement_days trading days later (CDSC's T+3).

strategy_tuning._comment: Re-tunes the momentum threshold, mean-reversion band and RSI levels (src/agent/strategy_tuner.py). Every interval_days, and at most daily for a strategy losing over at least min_closed_trades closed trades (win rate under poor_win_rate or a negative mean return), the current settings and each setting one step either side are run over up to two years of real daily history per symbol with at least min_bars bars, net of costs. A change is adopted only if it beats the current settings on the held-out latest holdout_pct by min_improvement, is no worse in-sample, and made min_trades trades in each. Adopted settings persist in data/strategy_params.json. enabled false freezes them.

benchmarks._comment: What each account is compared with on the dashboard (src/agent/benchmarks.py). The NSE paper account: Kenyan 91-day Treasury bills after withholding tax, and an equal-weight basket of the watched NSE stocks bought on its first day and held (price only). The US account: us_symbol. Update tbill_rate_pct when the CBK auction rate moves.

costs._comment: Per-side transaction costs by market. A single global rate cannot describe this portfolio: Alpaca is commission-free on US equities while an NSE round trip runs several percent. Set verified=true once you have confirmed a schedule with your broker.

us_equity.note: Alpaca charges no commission on US equities.

nse.source: AIB-AXYS fee schedule provided by the operator on 26 Sep 2026
nse.note: Per side: 1.30% brokerage on AIB DigiTrader (desk orders can reach 1.6%), statutory levies for the NSE, CMA, CDSC and ICF of 0.29-0.34% taken at 0.34%, and stamp duty of KES 2 per KES 10,000. commission_pct is their sum. Slippage is an estimate, not a fee. Never use the optional 5% instant-settlement fee: the paper account waits for T+3 settlement instead. Check the first real contract note against these figures.

crypto.note: Alpaca crypto taker fee at the lowest 30-day volume tier (0.25%; maker 0.15%): crypto trades on Alpaca, the Coinbase broker is off. It was Coinbase's 0.6%, which overstated every crypto round trip by 0.7%. Verify on Alpaca's crypto fee page.

forex.note: ESTIMATE: about one pip of spread a side on the major USD pairs; no commission.

regime_filter._comment: Momentum and mean reversion are opposed on entries. Rather than averaging them into a score neither can clear, let momentum vote only in trends and mean reversion only in ranges; the other abstains. A symbol with fewer than slow_period bars reads as unknown and is not filtered at all.

nse_screener._comment: Which NSE stocks the agent trades (src/agent/nse_screener.py). Every listed stock is screened weekly from its real history; the agent trades its holdings plus the best-ranked eligible stocks, at most max_per_sector from one sector, plus exploration_slots stocks ranked just below the cut (rotating weekly), up to max_symbols in all. Eligible: at least min_history_days real daily bars (what the strategies need to signal) and an average traded value of at least min_avg_value_kes a day (null: ten times nse_order_tickets.trade_notional_kes, since an order is capped at 10% of a day's volume). While too few stocks qualify, data_manager.nse_symbols fills the gaps. With llm_review, an AI may remove up to llm_max_removals names for a concrete reason (a suspension, a takeover offer). Set enabled to false to trade data_manager.nse_symbols as before.

claude._comment: Paid AI tier (src/agent/claude_provider.py), off unless ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in the environment. Then trade_review_model reviews every trade signal and volume_model does the high-volume JSON work, and the free Gemini/OpenRouter models become the fallback. Spending is priced from each reply's token counts and capped at monthly_budget_usd per calendar month (UTC); once the cap would be passed, only the free models are used until the next month. Spending is kept in data/ai_spend.json.

strategy_markets._comment: For each market listed, only these strategies vote on its symbols; a market not listed is open to every strategy (a strategy's own `markets` still applies). Crypto trades on the 200-day trend alone, as the gap analysis recommends: the fast strategies' daily signals cost too much there. Delete the crypto line to let every strategy vote on crypto again.

core_satellite._comment: US account only (src/agent/core_portfolio.py). The strategies trade active_share of equity, sizing every trade from that share; the rest is a core of low-cost index funds (S&P 500, 7-10 year Treasuries, gold) weighted so each carries about the same risk, rebalanced on the first session of each month or when a fund drifts more than drift_band from its target. The core never uses margin and has no stop-losses. Core funds must not be in data_manager.symbols (VOO, not SPY); any that are get dropped from the core. The gap analysis puts active_share at 0.50-0.60 for paper trading; when real money starts, begin lower and raise it in steps only while live results stay within tolerance of paper.

momentum_rotation._comment: Cross-sectional momentum: rank the universe by 12-1 return, hold the leaders, rebalance monthly. Distinct from the per-symbol `momentum` technical strategy. absolute_filter holds cash rather than buying the best-performing loser in a falling market.
